verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents registrable HTTP webhook destinations that attach to SQL-based monitoring rules. A programmatic consumer can therefore receive outbound callbacks when a rule fires. However, the only documented event source is alert rules, not a general event subscription system covering platform or service lifecycle events. Missing for 10: webhook events beyond alert-rule triggers, payload schema, signing/verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Organization-scoped, reusable Slack and HTTP webhook destinations you set up once and attach to any rule.
Turn any SQL query against your cluster into a monitored rule: set an operator, threshold, interval, and severity
